label: Linux

steps.label: Lua 5.5.1 (Titan fork)
steps.commands:
export PREFIX="$HOME/.local/titan/my-project"
curl -fL -o lua-titan.tar.gz \
  https://github.com/mascarenhas/lua-5.5.1/archive/refs/tags/v5.5.1-1.tar.gz
tar zxf lua-titan.tar.gz && (cd lua-5.5.1-5.5.1-1 &&
  make linux-readline PREFIX="$PREFIX" && make install PREFIX="$PREFIX")

steps.label: LuaRocks 3.13.0
steps.commands:
curl -fLO https://luarocks.github.io/luarocks/releases/luarocks-3.13.0.tar.gz
tar zxf luarocks-3.13.0.tar.gz && (cd luarocks-3.13.0 &&
  ./configure --prefix="$PREFIX" --rocks-tree="$PREFIX" \
    --with-lua="$PREFIX" --force-config && make && make install)

steps.label: Titan from LuaRocks
steps.commands:
export PATH="$PREFIX/bin:$PATH"
luarocks install titan
titanc --print-root

note: Requires gcc/clang, make, cmake, git, readline-dev, openssl-dev, and pkg-config.

label: macOS

steps.label: Prerequisites & Lua 5.5.1
steps.commands:
brew install cmake readline openssl@3 pkgconf
export PREFIX="$HOME/.local/titan/my-project"
curl -fL -o lua-titan.tar.gz \
  https://github.com/mascarenhas/lua-5.5.1/archive/refs/tags/v5.5.1-1.tar.gz
tar zxf lua-titan.tar.gz && (cd lua-5.5.1-5.5.1-1 &&
  make macosx PREFIX="$PREFIX" \
    MYCFLAGS="-I$(brew --prefix readline)/include" \
    MYLDFLAGS="-L$(brew --prefix readline)/lib" &&
  make install PREFIX="$PREFIX")

steps.label: LuaRocks 3.13.0
steps.commands:
curl -fLO https://luarocks.github.io/luarocks/releases/luarocks-3.13.0.tar.gz
tar zxf luarocks-3.13.0.tar.gz && (cd luarocks-3.13.0 &&
  ./configure --prefix="$PREFIX" --rocks-tree="$PREFIX" \
    --with-lua="$PREFIX" --force-config && make && make install)

steps.label: Titan from LuaRocks
steps.commands:
export PATH="$PREFIX/bin:$PATH"
luarocks install titan
titanc --print-root

note: Xcode Command Line Tools provides clang, git, curl, tar, and shasum. Homebrew readline is keg-only, so MYCFLAGS/MYLDFLAGS point Lua at it.

label: Windows

steps.label: Build SDK & Compiler
steps.commands:
mingw32-make -f Makefile.win lua PREFIX=/c/Titan/sdk
mingw32-make -f Makefile.win luarocks PREFIX=/c/Titan/sdk
mingw32-make -f Makefile.win compiler PREFIX=/c/Titan/sdk

note: The native x64 Windows port is experimental. Run from MSYS2 CLANG64 (with UCRT Clang, CMake, Ninja, Perl, and OpenSSL 3+ SDK installed, or pass OPENSSL_MODE=bundled); keep Lua SDK and LuaRocks tree in the same physical directory.
